q24.

```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178      — useCreateMemo() mutation hook; mutationFn calls memoServiceClient.createMemo({ memo })
web/src/connect.ts:197                   — memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport) (Connect client over the generated stub in web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts)
proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:21       — rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo); generated handler contract at proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go:409
server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:306 — ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo: unwraps req.Msg, delegates to APIV1Service
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70  — APIV1Service.CreateMemo: validation, UID generation, payload rebuild, then store.CreateMemo
store/memo.go:109                        — Store.CreateMemo: UID check, then s.driver.CreateMemo (interface at store/driver.go:29)
store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16               — sqlite.DB.CreateMemo: builds the INSERT INTO `memo` … RETURNING statement at store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41
```

Dialect note: the sqlite driver is one of three peers behind `store.Driver` — `store/db/postgres/memo.go:16` and `store/db/mysql/memo.go:16` implement the same hop.

Two hops are worth flagging as inferred rather than resolved calls: `memoServiceClient.createMemo` is a dynamic client member (no declaration to follow — the binding to `apiv1connect.MemoServiceHandler.CreateMemo` is name-based), and the driver dispatch at `store/memo.go:113` goes through the `store.Driver` interface, so the concrete dialect is chosen at wiring time, not at the callsite.
